create_unnest_nested_columns: create a function that unnests or explodes nested sequence columns in a pandas DataFrame
filter_out_mock_ratings: filter out mock ratings from a pandas DataFrame to remove worker bot data
add_numerical_ratings: add numerical ratings to a pandas DataFrame by converting string Likert ratings to integer values
filter_groups_with_repeat_participants: filter out groups with repeat participants from a pandas DataFrame based on worker IDs
filter_by_number_of_groups_of_min_size: filter a pandas DataFrame to keep only groups meeting minimum citizens, iterations, and rounds thresholds
